correctness.rationale: The exact cosine-sine principal-angle decomposition reduces the SPD product to blocks with trace a_i+gamma b_i and common determinant kappa gamma. At gamma>=1 trace ordering identifies the largest angle as the simultaneous global minimum/maximum eigenvalue source, including unpaired directions. The normalized trace a/sqrt(gamma)+b sqrt(gamma) has the unique constrained minimizer max(1,a/b); algebraic identity ab=kappa+(kappa−1)^2sin²theta cos²theta gives exact piecewise conditioning. Asymptotics follow by sin theta cos theta and gamma/kappa limits. Python/Numpy checker independently reconstructs 50 matrix configurations and 300 scalar boosts; finite checks are auxiliary only.

value.rationale: The unknown optimal inverse-projector gain on an approximate low-eigenspace is naturally motivated by SPD iterative solvers. The exact all-dimensional spectral classification identifies an actionable 45-degree stop-boosting threshold and a sharp O(kappa^(-1/2)) angular accuracy barrier for contrast-independent conditioning. These are not a renamed textbook perturbation estimate or isolated numerical special case; the claim exhaustively optimizes a noncommuting preconditioner family.
